clusters.headline: Search Ends at Bogor Illegal Gold Mine With 13 Dead And 14 Missing
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue teams have officially ended efforts to find missing miners at the Ciguha and Pongkor illegal gold mine sites in Bogor.
The incident resulted in 13 confirmed deaths, while 14 individuals remain missing and unaccounted for following the landslide.

clusters.headline: Budi Arie Questioned by Bareskrim Polri Over Listyo Sigit Treason
aiSummaryBullets: Budi Arie Setiadi underwent nine hours of questioning by Bareskrim Polri investigators as a witness in a treason case involving Listyo Sigit and others.
The former Communications Minister faced 42 questions, primarily regarding his alleged association with the suspects and a video he produced.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Government Coordinates Logistics Ahead Of Nataru 2027
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police are deploying 77,637 personnel to maintain public security during the 2027 end-of-year holiday period.
The Ministry of Trade is working to stabilize staple food prices and expedite beef imports to ensure sufficient supply for the holiday season.

clusters.headline: Four Suspects Named Following Death Of Student Silva Nur Intania
aiSummaryBullets: Police have officially designated four teenage girls as suspects in the assault leading to the death of a 17-year-old student.
Investigations reveal the victim, Silva Nur Intania Putri, suffered injuries from blunt force trauma according to autopsy findings.

clusters.headline: Wamendagri Ribka Haluk Dan Akhmad Wiyagus Tekankan Sinergi Daerah
aiSummaryBullets: Deputy Minister Ribka Haluk advocates for increased youth involvement in regional development to support the Asta Cita national agenda.
Deputy Minister Akhmad Wiyagus urges regional leadership forums to strengthen coordination to accelerate the resolution of local issues.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Affirms Indonesia Economic Stability At 5.47 Percent
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto stated that Indonesia's 5.47 percent economic growth reflects solid national fundamentals.
The remarks were delivered during the 2026 Bank Indonesia Annual Meeting held at the central bank's headquarters.

clusters.headline: Government Reaffirms Fuel Subsidy Stability Through End Of 2026
aiSummaryBullets: Airlangga Hartarto confirmed that government-subsidized fuel prices will remain unchanged until the end of 2026.
Finance Ministry official Suahasil Nazara emphasized that maintaining fuel price stability is essential for protecting consumer purchasing power.

clusters.headline: DSI Launches NADI Portal For Strategic Commodity Exports In 2027
aiSummaryBullets: DSI will launch the NADI portal for single-door exports of strategic commodities, including coal and palm oil, beginning January 1, 2027.
Exporting companies are required to register through the NADI system starting December 15, 2026, to ensure data transparency.

clusters.headline: Marc Marquez To Retire From MotoGP Following 2026 Racing Season
aiSummaryBullets: Eight-time world champion Marc Marquez will retire from professional MotoGP racing at the conclusion of the 2026 season.
The rider stated that recurring health issues, specifically diplopia caused by accidents at Mandalika and Le Mans, influenced his decision.

clusters.headline: Search Operation For Victims Of PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Fire Extended
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue efforts at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory site have been extended for an additional three days.
Operations have been complicated by unstable building structures and dangerous debris, requiring the deployment of K9 units.

clusters.headline: Agung Nugroho And Multiple Indonesian Entities Receive Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Agung Nugroho received an REI Award for his work in the housing sector.
Financial institutions including BNI, BRI, and MNC Sekuritas were recognized for excellence and transparency.

clusters.headline: Kombes Iman Imanuddin Dismissed By Police Over Case Termination
aiSummaryBullets: Kombes Iman Imanuddin was dismissed from the National Police following an ethics hearing.
The official was found to have violated ethical codes by ordering the termination of a case investigation.

clusters.headline: KPK Questions Wife Of ATR/BPN Official In Corruption Investigation
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK questioned the wife of an ATR/BPN Director General regarding alleged bribery payments related to HGB certificate processing.
Investigators searched a notary office in Surabaya to seize documents linked to the corruption case.

clusters.headline: Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono Undergo Health Exams for VP Role
aiSummaryBullets: Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono completed mandatory medical examinations at RSPAD Gatot Subroto as part of the vice-presidential selection process.
Results from the health assessments, conducted by 25 physicians, are scheduled to be formally announced on December 1.

clusters.headline: Bank Indonesia Governor Discusses Strategy To Protect Rupiah In 2027
aiSummaryBullets: Bank Indonesia Governor Destry Damayanti plans to strengthen the monetary policy mix in 2027 to ensure stability.
The central bank is responding to ongoing external pressures, including the influence of the US Federal Reserve and MSCI market sentiments.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Supports TUNAS Program for Digital Safety
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian endorsed the TUNAS program.
The initiative focuses on protecting children from negative digital effects.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Commends Kapolri For Internal Reforms
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto expressed appreciation for the leadership of Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto.
The President highlighted the police chief's initiative in addressing internal misconduct and abuse of authority within the force.

clusters.headline: Gerindra Regional Chapters And Allies Support Sugiono For Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Regional Gerindra party leaders in Nusa Tenggara Barat and other officials are expressing support for Sugiono as the new Vice President.
The National Mandate Party has signaled potential alignment with the proposal to appoint Sugiono to the vice presidential position.

clusters.headline: Komnas HAM Forms Selection Committee For 2027-2032 Commissioners
aiSummaryBullets: Komnas HAM has officially established a five-member selection committee to manage the recruitment of candidates for the 2027-2032 term.
The registration process for new commissioner candidates is scheduled to commence in December 2026.

clusters.headline: Polda Metro Jaya Responds To UI Students Protest On Rally Security
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya addressed a formal inquiry from University of Indonesia students regarding security tactics used during recent protests.
The regional police chief explained the standard operational procedures followed by officers when managing public demonstration crowds.
